% User has a role if they are in a group granted it, and includes transitively
has_role(User, Role) :- member(User, Group), granted(Group, BaseRole), includes_trans(BaseRole, Role).

% Answer: users who can read r03 and are not revoked

role_includes(Role, IncludedRole) :- includes(Role, MidRole), role_includes(MidRole, IncludedRole).

import "member.csv" as member.
import "grant.csv" as grant.
import "includes.csv" as includes.
import "permit.csv" as permit.
import "revoked.csv" as revoked.

% Transitive closure of role inclusions
role_closure(Role, IncludedRole) :- includes(Role, IncludedRole).
role_closure(Role, IncludedRole) :- includes(Role, MidRole), role_closure(MidRole, IncludedRole).
role_closure(Role, Role). % Reflexivity

% Effective roles for users
effective_role(User, Role) :- member(User, Group), grant(Group, BaseRole), role_closure(BaseRole, Role).

% Can delete if permitted and not revoked
can_delete(User, Resource) :- effective_role(User, Role), permit(Role, Resource, 'delete'), not revoked(User, Resource).

can_read(User, Resource) :- effective_role(User, Role), permit(Role, Resource, 'read'), not revoked(User, Resource).

% Answer: users who can delete but not read
answer(User, Resource) :- can_delete(User, Resource), not can_read(User, Resource).

% Load data from CSV files
import "instance.csv" as instance.
import "subclass.csv" as subclass.
import "declares.csv" as declares.

% Define sensor classes based on declares.csv
sensor(Class) :- declares(Class, 'type', 'sensor').

% Compute all subclasses of sensor classes
is_subclass_of(Class, Superclass) :- subclass(Class, Superclass).
is_subclass_of(Class, Superclass) :- subclass(Class, Mid), is_subclass_of(Mid, Superclass).

% Determine all classes that are sensors or subclasses of sensors
sensor_classes(Class) :- sensor(Class).
sensor_classes(Class) :- is_subclass_of(Class, Sensor), sensor(Sensor).

% Find instances that belong to any sensor class
answer(Instance) :- instance(Instance, Class), sensor_classes(Class).
